summary: Resolve Fractal environment aliases within each source layer before launch defaults, native resume selection and instance activation

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Declared aliases replace runtime defaults and inherited aliases as whole families. Explicit empty or conflicting identity values mask lower layers. Launcher-owned assignments still override both spellings. Fractal-only native paths dispatch to native hooks, authored resume selectors survive launch cleanup, and instance activation/current selection share Fractal-first resolution. Existing ST consumers keep equal launch aliases.

downtime.detail: No service replacement or seat restart required.

manual.detail: No action required for existing configurations. Resolve conflicting manually authored identity aliases before relaunching.

recovery.detail: No durable state changes. Existing ST names remain readable and exported.
